text:
Lantern: Which lantern is it?
Lantern. The board has 10x10 sites (160x160 cells). The window shows one site; each move goes to the next site (up, down, left or right). One large lantern hangs on an orange wall, with its handle at the top. Five parts sit in their places, each drawn in black; a part that sits at two or more sites shows the same shape at each of them: its handle at the top middle: a black square or a black triangle pointing up; its two hooks on the left and right below the handle: a tall thin black bar or three flat black stripes; its flame window at the centre: a black ring or a black eight-point star; its two side panes on the lower left and lower right: a black dome (flat side down) or a black bowl (flat side up); its base at the bottom middle: a wide flat black bar or a black V shape. Every other site shows plain orange wall. The whole lantern may sit one site higher, lower, left or right. Question: Which lantern is it? The answer is one of eight lanterns, each with its own parts: rello = a black triangle pointing up, three flat black stripes, a black eight-point star, a black bowl (flat side up), a black V shape; sanvi = a black triangle pointing up, three flat black stripes, a black ring, a black bowl (flat side up), a wide flat black bar; tobin = a black triangle pointing up, a tall thin black bar, a black eight-point star, a black dome (flat side down), a black V shape; ulmar = a black triangle pointing up, a tall thin black bar, a black ring, a black dome (flat side down), a wide flat black bar; vesna = a black square, three flat black stripes, a black eight-point star, a black dome (flat side down), a wide flat black bar; wilko = a black square, three flat black stripes, a black ring, a black dome (flat side down), a black V shape; yaren = a black square, a tall thin black bar, a black eight-point star, a black bowl (flat side up), a wide flat black bar; zorla = a black square, a tall thin black bar, a black ring, a black bowl (flat side up), a black V shape. Answer with its name. You may answer at any time; you do not need to see every site. Score: 20 if the answer is right, minus 10, minus 0.1 per move (movement budget 35).
The answers: 1 = rello, 2 = sanvi, 3 = tobin, 4 = ulmar, 5 = vesna, 6 = wilko, 7 = yaren, 8 = zorla.
